name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.2.35 replaces the live-battle PACK and PKMN full-screen Gold menus with Stadium-style four-row glass selectors that stay on the 3D battlefield. Pokémon switching, item use, party-target healing/status items and single-move PP restoration still call current Gen1Recomp battle routines underneath. FIGHT/RUN remain native-dispatched. The full 3D battle HUD, scenery clearing, movement/camera controls and Lugia safeguards remain.
